name: Apollo Command Module translation hand controller
view: the CM THC from behind, as the commander on the couch sees it: the T-handle on its shaft above the housing at the end of the left armrest; the handle is pushed the way the spacecraft should translate and turned about its shaft
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the T-handle and housing reconstructed from the public Apollo Command Module descriptions (NASA Apollo Operations Handbook overview, Apollo Flight Journal) and public museum photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
